recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy 1980s pop aesthetic featuring a low-angle portrait of a figure in vibrant streetwear set against a dramatic, dark blue twilight sky with soft clouds. The composition is anchored by aggressive, bright yellow hand-drawn lettering that overlaps a thick brushstroke underline.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant yellow clothing and text against a deep indigo/violet sky
Low-angle perspective creating a sense of scale and dynamism
Hand-drawn, gestural typography contrasting with the soft photographic background
Textural contrast between acid-wash denim and smooth airbrushed clouds
coreInvariants: Deep blue to purple gradient sky
Neon yellow as the primary accent color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure positioned from the waist up, angled slightly, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright yellow hand-drawn title in the upper third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright yellow text, moves down the figure's vertical line, and follows the diagonal lean of the body.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark sky area in the upper right and left corners to allow the text to pop.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Faded Denim Blue and Warm Skin Tones
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow elements against a low-value, moody background.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width mimicking a felt-tip marker
Sharp, aggressive terminals and long horizontal flourishes
Integrated underline using a thick, dry-brush stroke effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended crossbars that bleed into the background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary sans-serif block font is placed inside the thick brushstroke underline for metadata.
graphicDevices: Thin white border frame around the entire composition

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, gestural energy of the original lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photo of a person in a denim jacket and bright yellow pants, standing against a dark blue and purple twilight sky with soft, wispy clouds. The lighting should be dramatic, highlighting the figure from the front.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, hand-drawn neon yellow script lettering in the upper third. Include a thick, horizontal yellow brushstroke beneath the main text with secondary block text knocked out or printed on top.

verificationChecks: Is the sky a deep indigo/violet gradient?
Is the main text neon yellow and gestural?
Does the composition feel balanced yet dynamic?

adjustableVariables: Amount of acid-wash texture on the jacket
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow text is legible against the dark sky.
Check that the low-angle perspective is maintained.
Verify the 'marker' texture in the lettering strokes.
Confirm the presence of the thin outer border frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle portrait + Twilight sky background + Neon yellow hand-drawn display type + Thick brushstroke accent.
